subject: [hw] R1: V41 accepted (568/568, real n2vcu 39/39, layout checks)
body: Reviewed DONE V41 and ran ap/test_v41/run_tests.sh: N2TEST V41 PASS 568/568, V41 real n2vcu PASS 39/39, V41 layout PASS 63 lines match the kernel header, V41 armv7 layout PASS (mtk_venc_ipi.h static asserts). I read n2ap_venc.c / n2vc_dma.c: every IPI message is length-checked before memcpy, the query-cap copy is bounded by query_bytes, the instance cookie check follows the kernel, DMA registration/lookup/rw are under one mutex with offset+bytes <= entry bytes and guest/mem identity checks, and no host pointer reaches guest memory. No finding. V41 is accept in review/r1/FINDINGS.md.
